description: Stage-2 portfolio of 5-6 research-supported simulation profiles under the modular evidence architecture. Module labels use data/evidence-labels.json. 'verified_here' = opened primary in THIS project; secondary/search values are flagged. No production model is activated (Stage 3 not started).

profiles.name: Released small-molecule (niacinamide) transport through human skin
profiles.stage3_label: RESEARCH_SUPPORTED released-API skin submodel - NOT a nanoparticle release model

profiles.name: Topical NLC (celastrol/tripterine) release + skin permeation
profiles.purpose: genuine nanoparticle release -> skin transport (target profile)
profiles.profile_level: LEVEL_3_RESEARCH_SUPPORTED_COMPOSITE (PRIMARY VERIFIED this batch; single study, no external validation)
profiles.primary_source: chen-2012-tripterine-nlc (Int J Nanomedicine 2012:7 3023-3033, DOI 10.2147/IJN.S32476, PMC3392146) - full text opened this batch (aid B1)

formulation_size_EE.label: FORMULATION_SPECIFIC
formulation_size_EE.values: cationic 90.2+/-9.7 nm, PI 0.109, zeta +26.4 mV, EE 69.3%; neutral 87.8 nm, PI 0.113, zeta -2.7 mV, EE 67.8%; anionic 84.5 nm, PI 0.116, zeta -24.3 mV, EE 72.5% (n=3)

release_kinetics.label: FORMULATION_SPECIFIC
release_kinetics.note: connects directly to existing first-order release model in the tool

skin_permeation.label: DIRECT_EXACT
skin_permeation.values: rat full-thickness abdominal skin, Franz; flux 1.26/1.10/0.91 ug/cm2/h; perm coeff 2.10/1.83/1.52 x1e-3 cm/h; lag 0.43/0.42/0.52 h; cumulative(24h) 16.3/13.5/11.9 ug/cm2 (cationic/neutral/anionic)
skin_permeation.note: species mismatch: permeation=RAT skin, in-vivo PD=MOUSE

cellular_uptake.label: CARRIER_SPECIFIC
cellular_uptake.note: HaCaT + B16BL6 cells; surface charge affects uptake

in_vivo_PD.label: API_SPECIFIC
in_vivo_PD.note: B16BL6 melanoma-bearing C57BL/6 mice; cationic NLC highest antimelanoma efficacy (P<0.05)

validation.label: INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE
validation.note: single study; no INDEPENDENT external validation dataset; within-study comparators only

profiles.stage3_label: RESEARCH_SUPPORTED nanoparticle release->skin submodel (celastrol/tripterine NLC, single primary) - first VERIFIED genuine-NP profile; label 'single-study, rat skin, not externally validated'
profiles.residual_gaps: absolute D (cm2/s) needs SC/skin thickness; drug loading (mg/g) not transcribed; independent NP-skin validation study still wanted (aid B2 celastrol+indomethacin NLC)

profiles.name: Intact nanoparticle penetration in a tumour spheroid (carrier transport)
profiles.purpose: size-dependent intact-carrier penetration benchmark (uptake-return, not pure Fickian)

penetration_depth.label: UNVERIFIED_SECONDARY
penetration_depth.note: peaks 924/187 ppm; depths 21/22/15 um - dossier only

profiles.blocker: Chen 2024 primary not opened (dossier-secondary only). Ready as illustrative mechanism; NOT for quantitative use until primary + SI verified.

profiles.name: Tumour vascular-to-interstitial transport benchmark

governing_equation.label: DIRECT_EXACT
governing_equation.note: verified from user-provided primary images pp.335-339

permeability_intermediate.label: DIRECT_PARTIAL
permeability_intermediate.note: 10kDa=32, 70kDa=9.8 (x1e-7) from dossier/Fig3, not in the text pages provided

species_relevance.label: BENCHMARK
species_relevance.note: murine; dextran not a drug - benchmark only

profiles.stage3_label: MECHANISTIC_BENCHMARK (dextran, murine) - NOT a nanoparticle drug; primary-verified

profiles.name: PEGylated liposomal doxorubicin (Doxil) systemic PK + tumour delivery
profiles.purpose: clinically established nanoformulation; modular composite (formulation+PK now PRIMARY VERIFIED from FDA label; local tumour transport still missing)
profiles.profile_level: LEVEL_3_RESEARCH_SUPPORTED_COMPOSITE (formulation+systemic PK DIRECT_EXACT this batch; tumour-transport module INSUFFICIENT)
profiles.primary_sources: doxil-fda-pi (DailyMed PI Baxter rev 3/2026 + NDA 050718/S-060 authorized-generic label rev 5/2022, identical values), doxil-nda050718-s050 (FDA approval package incl. Clinical Pharmacology/Biopharmaceutics review + BE study DOXILNAP1004), barenholz-2012 (J Control Release 160:117-134) - all opened this batch (aids E1, E3)

formulation.label: DIRECT_EXACT
formulation.values: per mL: doxorubicin HCl 2 mg (=1.87 mg dox base); cholesterol 3.19 mg; HSPC 9.58 mg; MPEG-DSPE(PEG2000) 3.19 mg; ammonium sulfate ~0.6 mg; histidine 1.55 mg; sucrose 94 mg; pH 6.0-7.0; >90% encapsulated; dox HCl MW 579.99
formulation.note: label gives composition but NOT liposome diameter (~100 nm from Barenholz)

particle_size.label: BENCHMARK
particle_size.note: PEGylated unilamellar liposome <100 nm (~100 nm); label itself omits size

systemic_PK.label: DIRECT_EXACT
systemic_PK.values: total dox: Cmax 4.12/8.34 ug/mL; CL 0.056/0.041 L/h/m2; Vss 2.83/2.72 L/m2; AUC 277/590 ug/mL.h; lambda1 t1/2 4.7/5.2 h; lambda2 t1/2 52.3/55.0 h at 10/20 mg/m2; linear 10-20, nonlinear at 50 mg/m2
systemic_PK.note: contrast: conventional doxorubicin Vd 700-1100 L/m2, CL 24-35 L/h/m2 (label)

free_vs_encapsulated.label: DIRECT_PARTIAL
free_vs_encapsulated.values: >=90% remains liposome-encapsulated in circulation; assay cannot quantify <5-10% free; BE study estimated free = total-encapsulated (mass balance), 42% of samples negative, reviewer: 'may not yield reliable estimates of free doxorubicin'
free_vs_encapsulated.note: KEY teaching point: total != free; free not directly measurable by this assay

metabolism.label: DIRECT_EXACT
metabolism.values: doxorubicinol 0.8-26.2 ng/mL plasma at 10/20 mg/m2; plasma protein binding of doxorubicin ~70% (Doxil not determined)

tumour_accumulation.label: INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE
tumour_accumulation.note: label/reviews give NO spatial tumour penetration; Barenholz cites (secondary) malignant-effusion levels 4-16x free-dox from Gabizon [96]. Need primary intratumoral-distribution study (aid E4/Charrois-Allen aid E5)

local_release.label: ASSUMED
local_release.note: in-vitro release/dissolution profiles exist in S-050 but numeric values REDACTED (b)(4); release mechanism qualitative (Barenholz koff)

in_vitro_release_method.label: DIRECT_PARTIAL
in_vitro_release_method.note: dissolution timepoints 0.5/1.5/3/6 h, f2 similarity used; VALUES redacted as trade secret

validation.label: INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE
validation.note: S-050 shows site-to-site BE (GSK vs BVL, encapsulated+total dox) but NO independent biological/tumour validation

profiles.stage3_label: RESEARCH_SUPPORTED liposomal-doxorubicin systemic-PK + formulation submodel (DIRECT_EXACT from FDA label) - tumour-penetration outputs MUST stay disabled (no spatial primary)
profiles.residual_gaps: quantitative tumour concentration/penetration primary; numeric in-vitro release curve (redacted in label); Gabizon 2003 PMID 12739982 (free/encapsulated/tumour PK primary); Charrois & Allen 2004 (release-rate->tumour coupling, aid E5)

profiles.name: nab-Paclitaxel (Abraxane) systemic PK + carrier dissociation
profiles.purpose: distinct carrier class (protein NP); teaches carrier dissociation & free-vs-bound API

formulation.label: UNVERIFIED_SECONDARY
formulation.note: 130 nm albumin-bound, no excipients; dissociates to ~10 nm complexes on IV (search) - needs SmPC/label

free_vs_bound.label: MECHANISTIC_TRANSFER
free_vs_bound.note: rapid dissociation = key free-vs-encapsulated teaching point

profiles.alternative: Onivyde (liposomal irinotecan) - reverse-engineering PMC11791869; free/total SN-38 methodology
profiles.blocker: no opened primary/label; all values search-summary (UNVERIFIED_SECONDARY).

stage3_ready_now: B_celastrol_nlc_skin (PRIMARY VERIFIED this batch - first genuine-NP release->skin submodel; single study, rat skin)
E_doxil_liposomal_doxorubicin (formulation + systemic PK DIRECT_EXACT from FDA label; tumour-penetration outputs disabled)

portfolio_summary.outcome: OUTCOME B - portfolio of research-supported submodels/benchmarks; still no single externally-validated end-to-end NP drug profile, but two genuine-NP profiles (B, E) now have primary-verified modules
